verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official AI assistant built into the PlayCanvas Editor or engine for generating scripts, answering API questions, or scaffolding scenes. What it documents instead is an Editor MCP server that lets external AI assistants modify an open Editor session, plus PlayCanvas Skills that give third-party coding agents PlayCanvas-specific workflows. Both serve outside agents rather than being an in-engine assistant, so they belong to other stories (MCP server, agent skills) and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official AI assistant inside the engine helps with engine tasks — generating scripts, answering API questions, scaffolding scenes or assets
